text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwaiti and Syrian officials hold talks on ways of expanding trade ties.
- Saudi Arabia is expected to earn around $10 billion in extra income this year because of a surge in oil prices, higher non-oil exports, official report.
- Jordan plans to cut the cost of bread by 10 percent at the start of 1997.
- Gulf Cooperation Council secretary-general holds talks in Bahrain.
- Bank of Bahrain and Kuwait studies borrowing from Islamic financial institutions in 1997 to increase liquidity, bank chairman says.
